sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_file_name" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_s" > 0), "session_rpe" INTEGER NULL CHECK("session_rpe" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "notes" TEXT NULL, "routine_day_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_days (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "strength_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "weight" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight" >= 0.0), "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("reps" >= 0), "rpe" REAL NULL CHECK("rpe" BETWEEN 1.0 AND 10.0), "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "swim_details" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sessions (id), "pool_length_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("pool_length_m" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "swim_intervals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "stroke" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("distance_m" > 0), "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("duration_ms" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "swim_laps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "interval_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES swim_intervals (id), "lap_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("lap_number" > 0), "split_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("split_ms" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_details" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sessions (id), "distance_m" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("distance_m" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apnea_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_ms" > 0), "distance_m" INTEGER NULL CHECK("distance_m" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((kind = 'static' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'dynamic' AND distance_m IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_file_name" TEXT NULL, "weighing_notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_menus" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_plans (id), "day_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "menu_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_menus (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "timing_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_meals (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NULL CHECK("amount" > 0.0), "unit" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_free" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_free" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_guidelines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_plans (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose" TEXT NULL, "timing" TEXT NULL, "benefit" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "day_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routine_days (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "group_label" TEXT NULL, "warmup_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("warmup_sets" >= 0), "work_sets" INTEGER NULL CHECK("work_sets" > 0), "reps_min" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps_min" > 0), "reps_max" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps_max" > 0), "reps_note" TEXT NULL, "superset_with_previous" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("superset_with_previous" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cooking_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_weight_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("raw_weight_g" > 0.0), "cooked_weight_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("cooked_weight_g" > 0.0), "cooked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "with_other_ingredients" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("with_other_ingredients" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX sessions_user_started ON sessions (user_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX strength_sets_session ON strength_sets (session_id)
CREATE INDEX strength_sets_exercise ON strength_sets (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX swim_intervals_session ON swim_intervals (session_id)
CREATE INDEX swim_laps_interval ON swim_laps (interval_id)
CREATE INDEX apnea_attempts_session ON apnea_attempts (session_id)
CREATE INDEX plan_menus_plan ON plan_menus (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX plan_meals_menu ON plan_meals (menu_id)
CREATE INDEX plan_items_meal ON plan_items (meal_id)
CREATE INDEX supplement_guidelines_plan ON supplement_guidelines (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX routine_days_routine ON routine_days (routine_id)
CREATE INDEX routine_exercises_day ON routine_exercises (day_id)
CREATE INDEX cooking_batches_user ON cooking_batches (user_id, cooked_at)
